Mission Local reported that an after-school worker at Everett Middle School was arrested after the school received a report of inappropriate contact between an adult affiliated with the school and a student. The program was run by Mission Graduates. At the time of the initial report, police and the district were investigating, and it was unclear whether the suspect was being held in custody. A later report identified him as 20-year-old Jeremy Reyes and said he was accused of rape and sexual intercourse with a minor, booked on eight charges and held without bond.
